meta.title: KimKim - Gatherings, invites, shared event photos, and costs
meta.description: Plan weddings, gap circles, soccer, hunting trips, fishing weekends, and camping. Invite your people, track RSVPs, keep shared event photos, and split costs in one calm place. Built around Telegram.
meta.keywords: event planning, wedding, gap circle, choyxona, birthday, soccer, hunting trip, fishing, camping, picnic, shared event photos, Telegram, Uzbekistan

home.heroTitle:
Bring your people together.
Keep the plan clear.
home.heroSubtitle: Weddings, gap circles, and the weekends that usually stall in chat — hunting, fishing, camping, or soccer. One invite. RSVPs, photos, and who paid.
home.heroNote: Free to start. No password. It lives in Telegram.
home.heroSubtitleSignedIn: A wedding, a fishing weekend, soccer, or a quiet choyxona. Guests, updates, expenses, and shared event photos stay in one place.
home.catalogBody: A catalog of local businesses the community trusts. Vouch for places you know, and find recommended businesses in any category near you — in the list or on the map.
catalogPoints: Browse by category — from restaurants to digital agencies
Every listing is submitted by a real representative
Logged-in members can vouch for places they trust

features.eventsBody: Date, meeting point, guest list, and how you'll pay — set once, then shared with everyone you invite.
features.photosBody: After the wedding, the match, or the trip, guests add photos from the page or Telegram and save the rest in one tap.
features.commentsBody: Meeting point, gear, and who brings what live in one thread, not buried in the group chat.
features.expensesBody: Log who paid, split the boat, the pitch, or the dinner, and see the balance before anyone has to ask.
features.telegramBody: Invites, reminders, and updates land where your people already talk. Joining takes one tap.

home.closingBody: A wedding, a gap, a hunting trip, or a fishing weekend — open KimKim and send the invite.
